title: Sparstolonin B and Curcumin alleviate atherogenesis by modulating T helper 17-stromal cell interactions associated with interleukin-17 receptor A (IL-17RA) - transforming growth factor-beta-activated kinase 1 (TAK1) - nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-kappaB) signaling.
authors: Zhong, Guofu; Liu, Qingqing; Zhang, Qing; Yin, Wei; Luo, Zhihao; Lai, Yu; Tao, Siteng; Zhao, Zhen; Liu, Peizhong; Li, Chuangpeng; Sheng, Xiaogang; Wang, Dawei; Ding, Yu; Liu, Qing
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物通过IL-17RA-TAK1-NF-kappaB通路调节Th17-基质细胞互作缓解动脉粥样硬化，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是细胞免疫与疾病机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Sparstolonin B (SSNB) and Curcumin (Cur), from a pair of compatible herbs, were previously identified as anti-inflammation and T helper 17 (Th17) modulation reagents. However, their compatible roles in atherosclerosis (AS) and underlying mechanisms remain uninvestigated. METHODS: In vivo, the apoE(-/-) mice fed with high fat diet were used as mice model of AS. In vitro, macrophages, vascular smooth muscle cells (VSMC) were used in biological tests for vascular atherogenesis. For the Th17 differentiation, bone marrow-derived dendritic cells (DC) from wild-type mice were stimulated and co-cultured with sorted naive CD4(+)T cells from mice spleen, and. Functional assessments included flow cytometry, Oil Red O staining, ELISA, Western blotting (WB), and label-free proteomics of mouse peripheral blood. Molecular docking and Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) was used for evaluating binding affinity of ligands to target proteins. RESULTS: The gene-disease interaction and hub gene network reveals Th17-associated genes in the pathogenesis of atherosclerosis. In vitro, SSNB and Cur reduced oxLDL-induced BMDC activation by downregulating CD36. SSNB showed stronger inhibition to inflammatory activation of DC, while Cur more intensively suppressed co-stimulatory molecules. For the Th17/Treg bias in co-culture of BMDC and CD4(+)T cells, SSNB exerted a more significant inhibitory effect on Th17 differentiation, whereas SSNB and Cur exerted stronger effect on promoting Treg expansion. Cur exerts a more significant inhibitory effect on macrophages inflammation, and SSNB showed better inhibition of oxLDL uptake in VSMC foam cell formation. In vivo, SSNB and Cur reduced aortic atherosclerotic lesions and IL-17A in aortic valve, inflammatory cells infiltration and related Th17 immune response in apoE(-/-) mice. Proteomics identified proteolysis, oxidation-reduction, protein phosphorylation and metabolic process as top biological processes in the effects of SSNB and Cur. WB indicated IL-17RA-TAK1-NF-kappaB interaction as the related underlying molecular pathways. SSNB mainly inhibited TAK1 phosphorylation, while Cur more directly inhibited NF-kappaB P65 phosphorylation. Molecular docking indicated SSNB was superior binding to TLR4 and CD36 than Cur, and the binding result was further confirmed by molecular dynamic simulations and SPR verification. CONCLUSION: Our findings reveal, for the first time, that SSNB and Cur alleviate AS by modulating Th17-stromal cell interactions, with the IL-17RA-TAK1-NF-kappaB pathway as a related mediator. Notably, SSNB and Cur exhibit distinct anti-atherogenic roles. SSNB primarily targets TLR4/CD36 to inhibit DC activation, Th17 differentiation, VSMC inflammation and mainly inhibited TAK1 phosphorylation, while Cur more significant inhibited macrophage inflammation, and more directly inhibited NF-kappaB P65 phosphorylation. This study will be valuable for developing novel and precise adjuvant therapies for AS.
abstract_zh: 背景：Sparstolonin B (SSNB) 和姜黄素 (Curcumin, Cur) 源自一对相配草药，先前已被鉴定为抗炎和辅助性T细胞17 (T helper 17, Th17) 调节剂。然而，它们在动脉粥样硬化 (atherosclerosis, AS) 中的相配作用及其潜在机制尚未被研究。方法：在体内实验中，采用高脂饮食喂养的apoE(-/-)小鼠作为AS小鼠模型。在体外实验中，使用巨噬细胞、血管平滑肌细胞 (vascular smooth muscle cells, VSMC) 进行血管动脉粥样硬化发生的生物学测试。对于Th17分化，从野生型小鼠中获取骨髓来源树突状细胞 (bone marrow-derived dendritic cells, DC)，经刺激后与从小鼠脾脏分选的初始CD4(+)T细胞共培养。功能评估包括流式细胞术、油红O染色、ELISA、Western blotting (WB) 以及小鼠外周血的无标记蛋白质组学分析。采用分子对接和表面等离子体共振 (Surface plasmon resonance, SPR) 评估配体与靶蛋白的结合亲和力。结果：基因-疾病相互作用和核心基因网络揭示了Th17相关基因在动脉粥样硬化发病机制中的作用。在体外实验中，SSNB和Cur通过下调CD36减少oxLDL诱导的BMDC激活。SSNB对DC炎症激活的抑制作用更强，而Cur对共刺激分子的抑制更显著。在BMDC与CD4(+)T细胞共培养中的Th17/Treg偏向方面，SSNB对Th17分化表现出更显著的抑制作用，而SSNB和Cur在促进Treg扩增方面作用更强。Cur对巨噬细胞炎症的抑制作用更显著，而SSNB在抑制VSMC泡沫细胞形成中的oxLDL摄取方面表现更好。在体内实验中，SSNB和Cur减少了apoE(-/-)小鼠的主动脉粥样硬化病变、主动脉瓣中的IL-17A、炎症细胞浸润及相关Th17免疫反应。蛋白质组学鉴定出蛋白水解、氧化还原、蛋白磷酸化和代谢过程为SSNB和Cur作用中的主要生物学过程。WB表明IL-17RA-TAK1-NF-kappaB相互作用是相关的潜在分子通路。SSNB主要抑制TAK1磷酸化，而Cur更直接地抑制NF-kappaB P65磷酸化。分子对接表明SSNB与TLR4和CD36的结合优于Cur，该结合结果通过分子动力学模拟和SPR验证进一步确认。结论：我们的研究首次揭示，SSNB和Cur通过调节Th17-基质细胞相互作用缓解AS，其中IL-17RA-TAK1-NF-kappaB通路作为相关介质。值得注意的是，SSNB和Cur表现出不同的抗动脉粥样硬化作用。SSNB主要靶向TLR4/CD36以抑制DC激活、Th17分化、VSMC炎症，并主要抑制TAK1磷酸化，而Cur更显著地抑制巨噬细胞炎症，并更直接地抑制NF-kappaB P65磷酸化。本研究将为开发AS的新型精准辅助治疗提供价值。
